canonical_project: Niger national Tier III data center (DTS), PK5 Niamey
owner: Government of Niger (Ministry of Communication, New Information Technologies / MCNTI; ANSI) financed by African Development Bank (AfDB) under Trans-Sahara Optical Fibre Backbone project P-Z1-GB0-024
notes: National Tier III data center under the AfDB-supported DTS project: ANP (2025-02-27) reported minister announcement of AfDB support >9bn FCFA, 13% execution, planned reception 2025-09-30; WeAreTech (fr) confirms ~14.3M USD cost and 13% completion; AfDB 2025-11-21 press release lists installation of the Tier III national data centre as core component and 88 km Niamey urban loop connecting administrative sites; Air Info Agadez (2025-02-27) corroborates; BNEE EIES report locates the project at PK5, Arrondissement Communal Niamey V. No public reception/inauguration news found by 2026-08-12 (Sep-2025 target passed unconfirmed); Tier III claim not Uptime-certified (C/U). No MW capacity disclosed.
